chapter_title: Concerning the Ten Things that the Ambassador began by his Advent
chapter_note: Exceptionally clean substrate chapter. A systematic ten-fold enumeration of cosmic events initiated by the Third Ambassador's advent. Every item in the list maps cosmic process → cosmic outcome; both sides of every mapping remain within the cosmic system. No editorial bridge, institutional, or exhortation vocabulary detected anywhere. The only non-substrate material is the formulaic dialogue attribution in §1. The negative editorial fatigue score confirms no late-layer drift. The chapter preserves what appears to be a nearly intact cosmological teaching sequence — a numbered catalogue of the cosmic consequences of the Ambassador's advent (cosmic construction, ship movement, wheel activation, door openings, separation of sin, separation of night/day, fall of abortions, transmigrations).

paragraphs.core_text: The Ambassador performed ten works by his advent.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Once again the enlightener speaks:' — formulaic dialogue frame attribution with no cosmological content.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Standard dialogue frame opening wrapping a substantive topic statement. The topic statement defines the ten-fold enumeration structure and is integral to the teaching.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.87⟩
The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First enumeration item. 'The Great Builder' is a cosmic entity; 'the new aeon' is cosmic architecture. Both sides of the mapping are within the cosmic system. High substrate score (61.54) confirms.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second item. 'The ships' = cosmic vessels (sun and moon). 'Heights in the heavens' = cosmic geography. Pure cosmic process description.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third item. 'Wheels' are cosmic mechanisms (systematic cosmic process vocabulary). 'Life' sent to 'earth and upper worlds' maps cosmic process → cosmic geography. Entirely within the system.
Fourth item, almost entirely lost to lacuna. The enumeration marker 'The fourth:' survives, preserving the teaching structure.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth is the doors of the ships, that they were opened up [ ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fifth item. 'Doors of the ships' = cosmic mechanism (the ships' apertures for receiving purified light). Partially damaged but clearly substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth is the doors too [ ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Sixth item. A second set of doors, opened to receive 'the waste' (impure matter/dregs). Both sides cosmic — mechanism → cosmic substance. Partially damaged.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is [the sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Seventh item. '[The sin]' is a cosmic substance (personified agent — capitalized in function), separated from 'the rulers' (archons) by the Third Ambassador. All entities are cosmic. 'Fell upon the earth' = cosmic geography. The reference to the Third Ambassador is internal to the cosmological system, not editorial.

paragraphs.core_text: The eighth: Night and day were separated [ ... ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Eighth item. Cosmic temporal separation — a fundamental cosmological event. Partially damaged.

paragraphs.core_text: The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Ninth item. 'Abortions' are cosmic beings (offspring of archons, produced through the cosmic mechanism). Their fall is a cosmic event. High substrate score (50.0) confirms.

paragraphs.core_text: The tenth: Transmigrations came about in the zone.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Tenth and final item. 'Transmigrations' = cosmic process; 'the zone' = cosmic geography (the zodiacal zone or cosmic region). Completes the ten-fold enumeration cleanly. No editorial coda appended — the teaching sequence closes with its own structure.
